description: Capabilities granted to the Every Day window. Deliberately narrow: the webview has no network permission at all and its content security policy allows no outbound connection, so nothing it renders -- an entry, a task, an event fetched from a subscribed calendar, or a book cover downloaded into the vault -- can cause a request. Every socket in the application is opened by the Rust shell through src/http.rs, only for a calendar feed the user pasted in or a metadata lookup they asked for, and none of it is reachable from here.
